policy.purpose: predeclared optimization selection only; not a replacement release gate

limitations: One predefined baseline-then-optimized pair is not a statistical hardware benchmark.
Whole-window P95 includes settling time; the unchanged raw active-pointer overlap and fully-contained summaries are reported separately.

Selection uses a predeclared 10% fully-contained desktop P95 reduction, nonregressed active mean and original inputToNextFrame maximum, exact pixels and all original optimized budgets. It is not a new release acceptance budget.
RAF callbacks do not prove presented pixels or physical-device FPS.
This diagnostic does not replace final full-browser and exact Android gates.
